note: Private test build for Mario Kart World on the S2Arm engine: patches 0320 to 0331 on the verified 828 (docs/evidence/s2arm-mkw-60-0320-0331.md). The submit thread does less work per draw (texture-ID views kept until their own serial or pool changes, argument blocks rebuilt in part, audit probes sampled, per-shader binding facts, the Fair thermal scale retired when it holds nothing), the 300-frame summary no longer stalls one frame, the 0319 no-lock guard ignores one-frame interval-2 requests and stops an answered trial that grows the scene, bound textures' pages are read ahead at governor tier 1, and the log gains a dark-frame detector and a per-episode interval-2 trace. Every patch has its S2A_RB_* switch. Nothing is measured on an iPhone yet. Also in: the libretro JIT status and performance button, the libretro collection LibretroCores-ccd5f047 (DeSmuME JIT block table fix for the DS freeze of 828 with faster rendering, and the Beetle PSX Lightrec cheat fix; DeSmuME and the two Beetle PSX cores differ from 828), the NeoStation enhancements and HD texture identities, and the MeloNX bridge stall records. The MeloNX Core is the engine of IPA 822 with Nextendo kept (source e776bfd4, pin 7e48f06e, artifact 14869999889), asked for by the MeloNX session for the Hogwarts Legacy freeze.
